candidateOccurrences.reasonJa: Achaiaと並ぶMacedoniaの名が明記され、Jerusalemの貧しい聖徒のための献金の文脈。
candidateOccurrences.sourceText: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.
